explication: Applite is a native macOS cask-only app store backed by Homebrew. Users discover or search the catalog, select a cask, then install, update, open, or remove it; the app also supports custom taps, Brewfile migration, and Homebrew setup. The graph emphasizes the shared CaskManager and the documented local SQLite/FTS5 catalog. README capability descriptions supplement the sampled source; links for unsampled features are kept at subsystem level, and uncertain implementation wiring is omitted.
